title.rendered: WORD4TODAY: Something is about to happen.. 2

excerpt.rendered: Habakkuk 1:5 MSG-Part 2 ” Look long and hard. Brace yourself for a shock. Something’s about to take place and you’re going to find it hard to believe.…

content.rendered:
Habakkuk 1:5 MSG-Part 2 ” Look long and hard. Brace yourself for a shock. Something’s about to take place and you’re going to find it hard to believe.

(We are looking at this text literarily)

I love this statement…?
“Brace Yourself for a Shock.. “?

Brethren, there are pleasant surprises that can shock one & make one speechless & dumbfounded.

??Brace yourself, means get ready, it’s coming.

Note?
No matter how prepared you are for what’s coming, you will find out that when it comes,even with all your preparations, you will not have room enough to contain them.

The magnitude will be positively shocking. It will waoh you ?

Get ready, it’s coming…
It’s one blessing on the heels of another.

It’s blessings, favour everywhere you turn??
I don’t know what it is, but I perceive it’s something bigger than your imagination.

??You will be the beneficiary of God’s extravagant generosity this week in Jesus name ????
